lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li4Ga2Co2O8 (reduced formula Li2GaCoO4) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ga and Co centers each coordinated by four O neighbors in tetrahedral motifs, while Li centers show four O neighbors and O centers have five geometric neighbors (one Co, one Ga, and three Li). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-sharing between Co and Ga tetrahedra, with additional corner- and edge-sharing between O-centered five-vertex polyhedra.
